**Livemint** | "The Centre dismisses 'fake' claims on free laptop scheme" | Published: September 21, 2026 [1]
Reports that the Government of India, via the Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check unit, dismissed viral messages offering free laptops under schemes such as the 'National Student Laptop Scheme 2026' as fake [1]. PIB stated that the government has neither announced any such scheme nor invited applications from students, warning the public that these are phishing scams meant to harvest personal and banking details [1]. (Claims c1, c2, c3)

**All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)** | "Awareness Regarding Fake News of Pradhanmantri Free Laptop Scheme" | Published: April 29, 2024 [2]
AICTE issued an official circular notifying students and institutions that messages and circulars claiming the Government of India is operating a "Pradhanmantri Free Laptop Scheme" are fake [3] [2]. The statutory body cautioned that no such central scheme exists and warned against fraudulent registration portals [3] [2]. (Claims c1, c2, c3)

**ABP Live** | "PIB Fact Check: वायरल हो रहे मैसेज में दावा किया जा रहा है कि केंद्र सरकार छात्रों को फ्री लैपटॉप दे रही है" | Published: August 11, 2026 [4]
Debunks viral social media messages claiming the Central government is providing free laptops to students and directing them to an online link [4]. PIB Fact Check warned that the Central government runs no such scheme, the application deadlines and links are fraudulent, and clicking them risks compromising personal data and money [4]. (Claims c1, c2, c3)

**Hindustan Times** | "'Fake': PIB Fact Check debunks claims of 'National Student Laptop Scheme'" | Published: June 4, 2026 [5]
Details a PIB Fact Check alert warning citizens against circulating WhatsApp messages claiming registration is open for free student laptops [5]. The agency reiterated that the Government of India has not launched any free laptop scheme, confirming the circulating application links are fraudulent mechanisms to collect user data [5]. (Claims c1, c2, c3)
